_doc: Config + USER marks for scripts/artifact_queue.py (docs/design/artifact-staleness-queue.md). Each worker reads this file from ITS OWN checkout when it STARTS, so commit + push an edit AND pull it into every worker's checkout and restart that worker (stop, then start) for it to take effect. marks: [{deck, kind: mulligan|valueleaf, why, priority, date}] -- a marked artifact sorts first regardless of measured drift (higher priority first). Set with `artifact_queue.py mark`. recipe_overrides: {deck: fast|complete} -- a USER override of the never-below-the-incumbent plan (mull_plan).
